annotations.title: Restore a thread from the trash

description: Bring one thread, or one message of it, back out of the trash. A mailbox whose provider is imap puts a draft back in its drafts, the owner's own mail in sent mail and the rest in the inbox, each under a new id the answer names.

id.description: The threadId a search or a read answered, or with scope message the message's id.

mailbox.description: The mailbox's name or its email address.

scope.description: thread, the default, acts on the whole thread; message acts on that one message alone.

name: threads_untrash
title: Restore a thread from the trash
